Synthetic test-card review procedure, revision 1
Scope: reviewing a printed software-test card only. This is not a hardware maintenance procedure.
Prerequisites: the reviewer has the current approved synthetic test card and a blank software test record.
Hazards and limits: no equipment is involved; do not infer authorization for any physical operation.
Step 1: read the revision printed on the current synthetic test card.
Step 2: read the synthetic label from that same card; do not use a label from an older revision.
Step 3: record the observed revision and label in the software test record.
Completion: the reviewer has recorded both observations. This does not indicate any physical work was performed.
